sources.page_or_section_anchors: README annotation guidelines 1-6; JAMS namespace cue_point; local counts in 07_dati_benchmark/RIASSUNTO.md
sources.strongest_evidence: Complete official tree archive: 134 `.jams` files, 402 annotator records, 1.849 raw events (1.037 IN/812 OUT), 590 positive durations. Merging ±0,5 s gives 1.082 clusters with agreement sizes 1:547, 2:305, 3:230.
sources.transfer_limit: EDM-only; IN restricted to intro and OUT not before core by annotation design; agreement/timing labels are useful, not semantic closure rap.
sources.note: Revision 7fd692c has all 134 annotation files; the prior 634121-byte ZIP remains archived as mdjcue_partial_archive and is explicitly incomplete.
